metadata.sourceVintage: NRWN features mostly 2016 or earlier; retrieval date is not feature currency.
metadata.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada
metadata.weatherSampling: Model forecasts at independent chain endpoints and approximately 32 km spacing. Chains shorter than 3 km have no automatic weather sample. These are not weather stations.
metadata.milepostMethod: Calculated whole-mile reference points interpolated only inside monotone intervals containing published or Transport Canada anchors. Inconsistent mileage spacing is split using a 15% distance tolerance plus one 0.01-mile source posting step. No extrapolation or joining gaps. These are not surveyed or observed physical mileposts.
metadata.assetLimitations: Incomplete historical public inventory; missing records do not mean an asset is absent. Only assets positioned on the scoped historical CPR chains are included. Station records are not a complete list of railway operating points.
